content.rendered:
Pasta Pelican Birthday/ Graduation from Police Academy

Name: Lillian Stables
Event: Birthday/ Graduation from Police Academy
Location: Pasta Pelican Restaurant, 2455 Mariner Square Dr, Alameda, CA 94501
Guests: 50
Date: Friday, January 31, 2014
Times: 7:30 PM to 12:00 AM

_____________________________________________________________________________ 
Alameda DJ at the Pasta Pelican

Dinner Music

John Legend: Tonight (best you ever had)
Garth Brooks: Thunder Rolls
Kenny Chesney: No Shoes, No Shirt, No Problem
Bob Marley: Could you be loved?
Michael Buble: Everything
Queen: Somebody to love
Zac Brown Band: Chicken Fried
Speech/Toast
Kenny Loggins Danny’s Song

Dancing Music:

Mix top 40, a few country, hip hop: Empire State of Mind: Jay Z and Alicia Keys, , some oldies i.e: earth wind and fire : september, stevie wonder: for once in my life.
group dances : cupid shuffle, cha cha slide, electric slide, etc! (we love these!)

Happy Birthday Song Cake

More Dancing

_____________________________________________________________________________

Photo Booth . East Bay

Randy’s Dirty 30 and Graduation party
January 31, 2014
